Approved TBMPs: Biofiltration Systems, Design Pollution Prevention Infiltration Areas, Infiltration Devices, Detention Devices, Traction Sand Traps, Dry Weather Flow Diversion, Full-capture Trash Devices, Media Filters, Multi-chamber Treatment Train, Wet Basins, Bioretention, Open Graded Friction Course, Porous Pavement (Non-Highway Facilities Only)

extraction_quality.review_notes: Construction-phase BMP manual for Caltrans right-of-way projects. Post-construction TBMP sizing and water quality volume methods are in the Project Planning and Design Guide (PPDG), not this manual. RUSLE2 is required for surface-water-buffer equivalency; 2-year storm cited only as a common clear-water-diversion default.
